name: LawsuitFiles
title: The Lawsuit Files: Corporate America on Trial
description:
Corporate America has powerful lawyers. The public deserves the full story.

The Lawsuit Files investigates the legal battles that reveal how major companies operate and what happens when consumers, employees, regulators, and competitors fight back.

From landmark class actions and consumer rights cases to corporate fraud, privacy violations, deceptive business practices, contract disputes, and billion dollar settlements, each documentary reconstructs the case from the first complaint to the final ruling and examines what it changed.

No invented drama. No misleading headlines. Just deeply researched stories, verified facts, court records, competing claims, and the real consequences behind the lawsuits.

Subscribe to The Lawsuit Files: Corporate America on Trial.

This channel provides educational and documentary content only and does not offer legal advice.
